| colspan="2" style="text-align: center; padding-bottom: 10em;" | <span style="font-size: larger; padding-bottom: 2.5em">Who should dare to write their praise<br/>Do so in the plainest phrase,<br/>Few names last, where many lie,<br/>Even names of battles die.<br/>... Yvor Winters<br/><br/>In solemn memory of all those involved in World War II.<br/>With deepest respect, we remember.</span>
